decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly gaining board control by deploying efficient creatures and removal spells. The deck aims to efficiently utilize burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to clear the way for creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kor Skyfisher to deal damage quickly. Additionally, the deck includes card draw and graveyard hate with cards like Spare Supplies and Relic of Progenitus. The mana base includes land cards that provide colored mana sources to consistently cast spells and keep up with aggressive gameplay.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a steady stream of low-cost, efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Squadron Hawk and Thraben Inspector to quickly build a board presence, the player can then use cards like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech to pump their creatures and go for a quick, aggressive victory. Prismatic Strands and Journey to Nowhere provide removal and protection, while Militia Bugler and Raffine's Informant allow for card advantage and digging for key pieces. The deck's reliance on White creatures and spells make it a strong contender in the Pauper format.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kor Skyfisher, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to maintain board control and push through damage. The deck also includes artifacts like Relic of Progenitus and Experimental Synthesizer to provide additional utility and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of red and white sources, as well as bounce lands like Boros Garrison for added value.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, backed up by versatile removal and burn spells. It prioritizes efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Thraben Inspector to apply constant pressure on the opponent while utilizing cards like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt to control the board and clear the way for attack. The deck also includes some artifact cards to provide additional value and card draw, as well as a few land cards that can generate extra resources. Overall, the key concept is to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless assault and strategic removal.

This Red Deck Wins pauper deck is focused on quickly dealing damage to the opponent with low-cost, efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. The deck aims to control the board early on with removal spells like Searing Blaze and Lightning Bolt, while pushing for damage with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kessig Flamebreather. Reckless Impulse and Experimental Synthesizer help maintain card advantage and keep up the pressure. Overall, this deck prioritizes aggressive plays and fast-paced gameplay to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through card advantage and efficient removal spells while utilizing cards like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also focuses on improving consistency and dig through its library with cards like Brainstorm and Augur of Bolas. Additionally, it utilizes a snow-covered land package to enable cards like Skred and maximize the efficiency of its mana base. The inclusion of Moon-Circuit Hacker and Tolarian Terror adds versatility and additional control elements to the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, powerful creatures. By using cards like Ethereal Armor, All That Glitters, and Sentinel's Eyes, each creature becomes a potent threat. The deck includes ways to protect and buff your creatures, such as Benevolent Bodyguard and Emerge Unscathed. With a low mana curve and efficient creatures like Deftblade Elite and Lagonna-Band Trailblazer, this deck aims to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure to the opponent before they can mount a defense.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt, countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, and card draw like Brainstorm and Deep Analysis. The deck also aims to efficiently deploy threats like Cryptic Serpent and Murmuring Mystic to close out the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of snow-covered lands enables synergies with cards like Augur of Bolas and Tolarian Terror. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. By controlling the board early with cards like Lightning Bolt and Searing Blaze, while also applying pressure with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kessig Flamebreather, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. Additionally, cards like Chain Lightning and Fireblast provide additional reach to close out games. The deck relies on a mix of burn spells and aggressive creatures to maintain a fast-paced and proactive game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures and artifacts that provide additional value. By using cards like All That Glitters and Wedding Invitation to boost the power of creatures, combined with burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt for removal, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early. With a mix of efficient creatures and direct damage spells, this Boros Aggro deck looks to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize their board.

The main focus of the Dimir Control deck is to have a strong control over the game by countering opponent's spells, generating card advantage, and efficiently dealing with threats on the board. The deck includes a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw options to maintain control of the game. The deck also includes efficient threats like Gurmag Angler to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The synergy between these cards creates a powerful and effective control strategy that aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck utilizes cheap and efficient auras to pump up creatures quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats. By enhancing creatures with powerful enchantments like Ancestral Mask, Rancor, and Ethereal Armor, it aims to create massive threats that can end the game quickly. The inclusion of hexproof creatures like Silhana Ledgewalker and Slippery Bogle make it difficult for the opponent to interact with or remove these pumped-up creatures, allowing for consistent pressure and damage output. The deck also includes some mana fixing and disruption to support its aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and play aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Wild Growth, Arbor Elf, and Utopia Sprawl to accelerate mana production, the deck aims to drop threats like Boarding Party, Annoyed Altisaur, Avenging Hunter, and Generous Ent as early as possible. Removal spells such as Skred and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss help clear the way for attacks while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck thrives on tempo and pressure to secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive strategy by playing auras on evasive creatures, such as Slippery Bogle and Gladecover Scout. By enchanting these creatures with powerful auras like Rancor, Ancestral Mask, and Ethereal Armor, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. The inclusion of cards like Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth helps to ensure a consistent mana base, while cards like All That Glitters and Armadillo Cloak provide additional damage output and resilience. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly building up a threatening board presence to outpace the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and spells. The focus is on utilizing low-cost and efficient cards to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the board. By combining artifact creatures, burn spells, and bounce effects, this deck aims to maintain a strong tempo while constantly pressuring the opponent. The mana base includes a mix of lands that provide flexibility and consistency in casting spells. Overall, this deck aims to establish early dominance and close out the game swiftly.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by constantly disrupting the opponent's plans with a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Archaeomancer to recycle key spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to outlast the opponent while generating value through cards like Mulldrifter and Augur of Bolas. The mana base is focused on snow lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck is designed to be resilient and adaptable in various matchups.
